## Limitations & Phase 3 Requirements

| Limitation | Impact | Phase 3 Fix |
|-----------|--------|------------|
| Heading drift not corrected by ML | Trajectory curves away | Map-matching road alignment |
| Velocity model trained on synthetic only | Sim-to-real gap | Fine-tune on real IO-VNBD when LFS resolves |
| ZUPT only for stationary | Slow-creep not caught | Odometry fusion at turns |
| EKF diverges in long urban outages | Position error grows | Map constraint + particle filter |
| No magnetometer heading correction | Heading bias | Soft-iron calibrated mag fusion |

*Phase 2 baseline — AI/ML enhanced, honest gap-to-target reported*
